t: Ready mixed compound ideal for those not wishing to use scrim tape. Hardwearing once dry and also harder to sand down. Gypsum based with a high polymer content, this product has been designed for jointing plasterboards without the use of scrim tape and is ideal to fill in distressed areas that are susceptible to cracking or where cracking reappears (for example, around windows and doors). Ultra-strong formulation, also making it ideal for filling, smoothing walls, ceilings and plasterboard repairs in areas susceptible to movement. White colour of plaster ensures a lower number of coats while painting.
